content_zh:
之所以有这么大名气，其一自然是高档的消费群体和服务质量；其二则是被人茶余饭后津津乐道的黑狼帮背景。
陈阳看着门口一排站得整整齐齐的黑衣大汉，一个个虎背熊腰，眼神冷厉彪悍，可不是一般的小混混所能有的素质。
“看来这黑狼帮还真有些门道，想必在学校收保护费的疯狗只是外围成员。”
陈阳心头暗道，把二八大杠停在了皇潮阁门口，对从大杠上下来的杨雪薇道：“杨老师，这皇潮阁还是太危险了，你跟我一起进去，万一有个三长两短，我怎么对得起你。我看你还是在外面等我，我独自进去，和他们讲讲道理，他们应该会听的。”
杨雪薇苦笑了下，这些人一个比一个坏，怎会听你讲道理。
不过她转念一想，陈阳也说得对，她留在外面，万一真有什么情况，还能报警救陈阳，可若是两人都陷进去，想逃也逃不掉了。
“好，我在这里等你，如果半个小时你没出来，我就报警。”杨雪薇点了点头，一脸郑重道。
“放心，杨老师，我给他们道歉，好好和他们讲，他们应该不会为难我的。”
陈阳面色凛然，昂头阔步朝着皇潮阁里走去。
转身的刹那，他呆萌的表情一变，眼神中闪过一丝极度的阴冷。
真是开玩笑，区区一个东安市的帮派，竟然想让全世界兵王闻风丧胆的“上帝”道歉，这可能吗？
至于陈阳说的好好讲，当然要好好讲，不过他向来喜欢先揍别人一顿，再好好讲。
“陈阳，你小心！”
望着陈阳高大的背影，杨雪薇往前追了两步，这才停下。
这一刻，她觉得陈阳虽然是个穷学生，但却拥有正义感，只身犯险，令她敬佩而又心疼。
突然间，她觉得鼻尖有些发酸，只能在心里默默祈祷：“陈阳可千万不要有事，不然的话，我当老师的，这辈子都难以心安。”
在一排黑衣大汉的瞩目下，陈阳旁若无人地朝着皇潮阁里走去，神态自若，根本就像没看到这些人。
这些黑衣大汉早就注意到了陈阳，见他骑着辆破自行车，却载着个媚到骨子里的美女，他们是羡慕嫉妒恨，恨不得上去揍陈阳一顿。
此刻见陈阳竟然无视他们，他们就更不乐意了。
如果皇潮阁不是开门迎客，他们立即就扑上去揍陈阳一顿了，不过虽然会所有规矩，但不代表他们没办法整治陈阳。

当即黑衣大汉分成两列，朝着陈阳快步走过来，和他保持了一步的距离，将他团团围住，一个个虎视眈眈，眼神中满是煞气，仿佛像是要把陈阳吃了。
陈阳不屑地冷笑一声，他经历过无数生死瞬间，见识过世人无法理解的高人，眼前几个混子竟然想吓唬他，拦他的路，当真是螳臂当车。
他气势外放，一股冰冷到骨子里的血腥气机将周围笼罩，充满了杀戮之气。
几名刚才还嚣张的黑衣大汉，顿时面色骤变，不由自主地往后退了数步，让开了道路，等陈阳进了皇潮阁，他们这才反应过来，却已是汗流浃背。
陈阳进了皇潮阁，一名穿着职业套装，身材性感的迎宾小姐走了过来，她看向穿着普通的陈阳时，眼中闪过一丝不屑，随即嘴角勾起专业的微笑：“这位先生，请问你有什么需要，如果要上洗手间的话，对不起，我们这里不对外提供。”
“让魏勇来见我。”
陈阳扔下一句话，没有理会傻眼的迎宾小姐，径直坐在了大厅的沙发上，翘起二郎腿，摸出一根烟抽了起来。
迎宾小姐皱了下眉头，上前道：“这位先生，你确定是要见我们魏总，如果要见他，是需要预约的。另外如果你想捣乱，我友情提醒你，昨天一位撒酒疯的顾客已经进了医院，据说要睡三个月才能下床。”
听到对方的威胁，陈阳笑了笑，吐出一个烟圈：“告诉魏勇，就说我是东安工大的陈阳，特地来找他的。”
“嘁，这么拽，原来只是个学生。”
迎宾小姐厌恶地扇了扇空气中的烟雾，转身后，迈着轻盈的猫步走开。
不一会，一名面容精瘦，穿着藏蓝色西装的塌鼻梁中年男人走了过来。
他看了眼坐在沙发上没动的陈阳，脸上露出不悦之色：“你就是打了疯狗的那个大学生？呵呵，进了皇潮阁竟然还坐得住，真不知道该是佩服你，还是说你无知。”

content_en:
The reason why it is so famous is naturally the high-end consumer group and service quality; the second reason is the background of the Black Wolf Gang that people talk about after dinner.
Chen Yang looked at the row of tall men in black standing neatly at the door. They were all hunky-backed and had cold and fierce eyes. They were not qualities that ordinary gangsters could possess.
"It seems that this Black Wolf Gang really has some skills. Presumably the mad dog who collects protection fees in the school is just a peripheral member."
Chen Yang thought to himself, and stopped the 28th pole at the entrance of Huangchao Pavilion, and said to Yang Xuewei who got off the pole: "Teacher Yang, this Huangchao Pavilion is still too dangerous. If you go in with me, if something happens to you, how can I be worthy of you? I think you should wait for me outside. I will go in alone and talk to them. They should listen."
Yang Xuewei smiled bitterly. Each of these people is worse than the last. How can they listen to your reasoning?
But then she thought about it, and Chen Yang was right. If she stayed outside, she could call the police to save Chen Yang if anything happened. But if both of them were trapped, they wouldn't be able to escape even if they wanted to.
"Okay, I'll wait for you here. If you don't come out in half an hour, I'll call the police." Yang Xuewei nodded and said solemnly.
"Don't worry, Teacher Yang. I'll apologize to them and talk to them properly. They shouldn't make things difficult for me."
Chen Yang looked solemn and walked towards the Huangchao Pavilion with his head held high.
The moment he turned around, his cute expression changed, and a trace of extreme coldness flashed in his eyes.
What a joke. A mere gang from Dong'an City actually wants the "God" who is frightened by soldiers all over the world to apologize. Is this possible?
As for Chen Yang's words, of course he should speak well, but he always likes to beat others up first and then speak well.
"Chen Yang, be careful!"
Looking at Chen Yang's tall back, Yang Xuewei took two steps forward and then stopped.
At this moment, she felt that although Chen Yang was a poor student, he had a sense of justice and took risks alone, which made her admire and feel distressed.
Suddenly, she felt the tip of her nose was a little sore, and she could only pray silently in her heart: "Don't let anything happen to Chen Yang, otherwise, as a teacher, I will never be able to feel at ease in my life."
Under the attention of a row of big men in black, Chen Yang walked towards the Huangchao Pavilion as if no one else was watching, with a calm demeanor, as if he had not seen these people at all.
These big men in black had noticed Chen Yang a long time ago. When they saw that he was riding a broken bicycle and carrying a charming beauty, they were envious and jealous and wanted to go up and beat Chen Yang up.
Seeing Chen Yang ignoring them now, they were even more unhappy.
If Huangchao Pavilion had not opened its doors to welcome guests, they would have immediately pounced on Chen Yang and beat him up. However, although they knew all the rules, it did not mean that they could not punish Chen Yang.
Immediately, the big men in black divided into two columns and walked quickly towards Chen Yang, keeping a step away from him, and surrounded him. Everyone looked at him with eager eyes, their eyes full of evil intent, as if they wanted to eat Chen Yang.
Chen Yang sneered disdainfully. He had experienced countless moments of life and death, and had seen masters that the world could not understand. The few gangsters in front of him actually wanted to scare him and block his way. They were really trying to do something like a mantis.
His aura was exuding, and a blood-chilling aura that was cold to the bone enveloped the surrounding area, full of murderous aura.
The expressions of several big men in black who had been arrogant just now suddenly changed. They involuntarily took a few steps back and got out of the way. When Chen Yang entered the Huangchao Pavilion, they finally realized what was happening, but they were already covered in sweat.
Chen Yang entered the Huangchao Pavilion, and a welcoming lady wearing a business suit and a sexy figure came over. When she looked at Chen Yang, who was wearing ordinary clothes, a trace of disdain flashed in her eyes, and then a professional smile appeared at the corner of her mouth: "Sir, what do you need? If you want to use the restroom, I'm sorry, we don't provide it here."
"Let Wei Yong come to see me."
Chen Yang dropped a sentence,Ignoring the dumbfounded receptionist, he sat directly on the sofa in the hall, crossed his legs, took out a cigarette and started smoking.
The welcoming lady frowned and stepped forward and said, "Sir, are you sure you want to see our Mr. Wei? If you want to see him, you need to make an appointment. Also, if you want to cause trouble, I would like to remind you that a drunken customer went to the hospital yesterday. It is said that he will need to sleep for three months before he can get out of bed."
Hearing the threat from the other party, Chen Yang smiled and blew out a smoke ring: "Tell Wei Yong that I am Chen Yang from Dong'an University of Technology and came to see him specially."
"Hey, you're pulling so hard, it turns out you're just a student."
The receptionist fanned the smoke in the air in disgust, turned around, and walked away with light cat steps.
After a while, a middle-aged man with a lean face and a flat nose wearing a navy blue suit came over.
He glanced at Chen Yang, who was sitting motionless on the sofa, with a look of displeasure on his face: "Are you the college student who beat up the mad dog? Haha, you can still sit still after entering the Huangchao Pavilion. I don't know whether I should admire you or call you ignorant."
